label: Diagram 3.13
caption: Diagram 3.13 Sanitary fittings, associated access zones and permitted encroachment of basis for second WC/cloakroom where on same floor level as first WC
description: This is a plan showing two layouts of sanitary fittings with clear access zones. Left: a grey rectangular zone dimensioned 700mm wide by 900mm high, a WC at the bottom edge, and a vertical dashed centreline from the top edge to the WC. Right: a grey access zone with a WC at the bottom edge, centre. Two basins sit at the top, each marked 200mm max for the projection into the zone; the top is dimensioned 350mm and 750mm, the left 900mm and 750mm. A third basin at the lower right is also marked 200mm max. A bottom dimension reads 450-500mm. Dashed lines outline the encroachment zones around the basins. The Key reads 'a WC clear access zone (refer to Diagram 2.5)'; 'b,c Alternative permitted locations for a wash hand basin (within a bathroom) or a hand rinse basin (within a WC)'; plus a note that dashed zones show where a basin may encroach into the WC clear access zone. A footnote states '*all dimensions are minimum except where noted'. Caption: 'Diagram 3.13 Sanitary fittings, associated access zones and permitted encroachment of basis for second WC/cloakroom where on same floor level as first WC'.
